pr_title: *: add unnecessary untracked files to .gitignore and clean up them
pr_body:
### What problem does this PR solve?
Issue Number: close #49070

Problem Summary: 
After `make test` or `make ut`, some unnecessary files can be shown as untracked files for git. We should prevent accidental commit for them.

### What changed and how does it work?
After this change, files pointed out in #49070 won't be shown in untracked files and you can remove them by executing `make clean`.

There are 3 types of files which are reported in the issue.

#### `./test_coverage`
Since test coverage files should be committed, ignoring this folder makes sense.

#### `**/replayer`
Although 3 folders are reported (`pkg/executor/test/executor/replayer/`, `pkg/server/handler/optimizor/replayer/`, `tests/integrationtest/replayer/`), `replayer` folder can be made in more places. (e.g. `./pkg/server/replayer`, `./pkg/domain/replayer`, ) . I added file names instead of listing folder names.

The file names and the folder name are defined here.
https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/master/pkg/util/replayer/replayer.go#L73-L87

Ignoring `**/replayer` except for `./pkg/util/replayer` can be an option. But I don't choose it because I can't ensure that no one will add another `**/replayer`.

#### `.pkg/domain/extract/`
The folder can be created in https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/master/pkg/domain/extract.go#L493-L494
But I can't see any untracked files in this folder since folder deletion is done in each test case( e.g. https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/master/pkg/domain/extract_test.go#L38).

I added this case in case I missed something.

issue_context.title: please add unnecessary untracked files to gitignore and should clean them up in `make clean`
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

After I failed to run `make test` or `make ut`, I found that following paths exists and you can see that `git` treats them as untracked files. 

```
Untracked files:
  (use "git add <file>..." to include in what will be committed)
	pkg/domain/extract/
	pkg/executor/test/executor/replayer/
	pkg/server/handler/optimizor/replayer/
	test_coverage/
	tests/integrationtest/replayer/
```

so it is better to add them in `.gitignore` file and to remove them with `make clean`
